environment.description: Same application image deployed via gVisor (runsc) runtime with a custom OCI runtime spec. The container's rootfs is a minimal scratch-based image with only the dotnet runtime and application DLLs. The process runs inside a pivot_root jail where the new root contains: /app (read-only bind mount of application binaries), /tmp (tmpfs, noexec), and /proc (masked). No /bin, /usr, /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, or any shell binary exists in the filesystem namespace. Environment variables are injected via Kubernetes downward API with only PORT=8080 and ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production (no secrets). The container spec sets readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, and the pod has an emptyDir volume for /tmp only. Network policy restricts egress to the cluster DNS and the application's own database service IP only.

config.secrets_injection: none - secrets fetched at runtime from Vault sidecar over localhost:8200 and held only in memory
config.network_policy: egress only to kube-dns (UDP 53) and postgres-service:5432
